name: vm_exec
description: Run a PowerShell script on the Windows robot VM and get its output. The VM is a persistent Windows Server with git, node, corepack/pnpm on PATH; rg (ripgrep) is installed in C:\\vm-agent\\bin, which is not on PATH in a fresh session - prepend that directory to PATH at the top of every script; the repo is at C:\vm-agent\repo. Returns the exit code, the last 8000 chars of merged stdout+stderr, and the bucket path of the complete log. WorkDir, RunId and a 3-minute timeout are fixed by the flow. Each call costs 45-75 seconds of fixed overhead regardless of script length, so batch: one call should run every command a step needs, with Write-Output '### <label>' separators. Output is capped at 8000 chars, so filter (rg -n, Select-String, Select-Object -First N, Get-Content -TotalCount N) instead of dumping whole files.

Script.description: PowerShell script to run on the VM. Multiple lines allowed. Runs with powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass. Batch several commands per script (with Write-Output '### <label>' separators and $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'); one command per call wastes the ~40 s fixed cost of each call.

WorkDir.description: Working directory on the VM. Fixed by the flow (C:\vm-agent); do not set.

RunId.description: Log grouping prefix in the storage bucket. Fixed by the flow; do not set.

TimeoutMinutes.description: Fixed by the flow at 3 minutes; do not set. Exit code 124 means it timed out.

Stdout.description: Merged stdout+stderr, tail-truncated to 8000 chars; full log in the bucket at OutputBlobPath

OutputBlobPath.description: Path of the complete log inside the e2e-investigations bucket
